title: Safeguards to Prevent Rise in Online Gambling Addiction
what_it_is: Safeguards to Prevent Rise in Online Gambling Addiction

sections.label: Safeguards against online gambling addiction
sections.summary: A question asked the Minister for Social and Family Development about safeguards against increased online gambling addiction given pending approval of exempted online providers.

sentences.speaker: Mr Christopher de Souza
sentences.text: asked	the Minister for Social and Family Development what are the safeguards to prevent an increase in online gambling addiction in light of the pending approval of exempted online providers.

sections.label: Minimum age for remote gambling
sections.summary: All account holders must be at least 21 years old before opening a remote gambling account, to prevent youth gambling.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Tan Chuan-Jin)
sentences.text: To prevent youth gambling, all account holders must be at least 21 years old before they can open a remote gambling account.

sections.label: Daily expenditure and funding limits
sections.summary: All account holders must set a daily expenditure limit and funding limit before placing bets, to prevent over-spending and addiction.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Tan Chuan-Jin)
sentences.text: To prevent over-spending and addiction, all account holders will be required to set a daily expenditure limit and funding limit before they are allowed to place bets.

sections.label: Responsible gambling messages and advertising approval
sections.summary: Exempted operators must display responsible gambling messages, alert individuals at 75% of their daily limit, and submit advertising materials to MSF for approval.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Tan Chuan-Jin)
sentences.text: To facilitate informed play, the EOs are required to display responsible gambling messages prominently, such as the time and amount spent, the total win/losses for the day, and alert the individual if he has reached or exceeded 75% of his daily expenditure limit.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr Tan Chuan-Jin)
sentences.text: Lastly, the EOs will be required to submit all advertising and promotion (A&P) materials to MSF for approval.

sections.label: Timeline of Remote Gambling Act
sections.summary: The Bill was debated in October 2014, came into force in February 2015, and as of October 2016 meant 20 months of a total ban.

sentences.speaker: Mr Christopher de Souza
sentences.text: The Bill was debated in October 2014; it came into force in February 2015; it is now October 2016.

sentences.speaker: Mr Christopher de Souza
sentences.text: That would mean 20 months of a total ban.

sections.label: Managed space with social safeguards
sections.summary: A speaker states a tightly managed space with social safeguards is believed to help, and asks whether making online gambling legitimate encourages more people to gamble online.

sentences.speaker: Mr Tan Chuan-Jin
sentences.text: That is a real thing that is happening today in the course of the last many months after the Remote Gambling Act was put in place.

sentences.speaker: Mr Tan Chuan-Jin
sentences.text: We believe that having a tightly managed space with social safeguards would help, but if it turns out that there continue to be issues, we will have to take a look at how best to deal with this.

sentences.speaker: Er Dr Lee Bee Wah (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: Are you not encouraging more people to go online gambling by making it legitimate?

sections.label: Online gambling without safeguards
sections.summary: Singaporeans are gambling online in a space with no social safeguards and no monitoring.

sentences.speaker: Mr Tan Chuan-Jin
sentences.text: The reality is that there are Singaporeans who are gambling online and they are gambling in a space where there are no social safeguards, no monitoring.

sections.label: Controlled space with safeguards
sections.summary: A fairly controlled, tightly managed space with social safeguards is proposed as one way to deal with the issue.

sentences.speaker: Mr Tan Chuan-Jin
sentences.text: But how best to deal with the issue?

sentences.speaker: Mr Tan Chuan-Jin
sentences.text: We believe that having this fairly controlled, tightly managed space with social safeguards will be one way to deal with it.

sections.label: New measures for online gambling
sections.summary: The Member asks what new measures beyond baseline measures address online gambling, whether such measures will be introduced, and the daily expenditure and funding limits.

sentences.speaker: Mr Pritam Singh (Aljunied)
sentences.text: In view of the differences between online and terrestrial gambling, what are the new measures – and I emphasise, new measures – that have been undertaken by the Ministry beyond the baseline measures to address the negative effect of online gambling at all levels – upstream, midstream and downstream?

sentences.speaker: Mr Pritam Singh (Aljunied)
sentences.text: Can the Minister please brief this House as to whether such measures, specific to online gambling, are going to be introduced?

sentences.speaker: Mr Pritam Singh (Aljunied)
sentences.text: And in this vein, as the Minister just mentioned, what are the expenditure and funding limits for online gambling on a daily basis, in specific numbers?

sections.label: Exclusions and gambling limits
sections.summary: As at 30 June 2016, about 51,000 individuals under casino exclusions cannot open remote gambling accounts; funding and expenditure limits are listed.

sentences.speaker: Mr Tan Chuan-Jin
sentences.text: As at 30 June 2016, approximately 51,000 individuals are under the relevant casino exclusions and will be prohibited from opening a remote gambling account.

sentences.speaker: Mr Tan Chuan-Jin
sentences.text: Well, the funding limit will be $300, $500, $1,000 and part of it will be user-defined.

sentences.speaker: Mr Tan Chuan-Jin
sentences.text: Expenditure limits are $50, $75, $100, $125, $150, $200, $250, $300 and user-defined.

sections.label: Responsible gambling requirements
sections.summary: Requirements include responsible gambling messages, a risk warning before login, a time counter, and information such as win/loss and limit pop-ups and statements.

sentences.speaker: Mr Tan Chuan-Jin
sentences.text: Requirements are as follows: (a) display of responsible gambling messages, which means they need to display responsible gambling messages on all remote gambling web pages; (b) players must acknowledge a warning message of the risk of problem gambling before logging in; (c) display of a time counter to indicate the time spent since the player logged into the account; and (d) the provision of information to players to facilitate informed play, for example, a pop-up message indicating the player's total wins/losses for the day is displayed at log-out, an additional pop-up message indicating the player has exceeded 75% of his daily expenditure limit, and the player can access online monthly or weekly statements of the player's past gambling activities to allow for informed play.
